title: How Cars24 scales conversations and builds faster with OpenAI
summary: Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle 1M+ monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads, and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company.
body: Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle 1M+ monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads, and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company.
summaryZh: 汽车交易平台Cars24利用OpenAI驱动的语音和聊天代理处理每月超过100万分钟的对话，成功恢复了12%的流失线索，并将智能体工作流扩展到公司各个团队，展示了LLM智能体在现实企业中的落地成效。原始信息显示：Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle 1M+ monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads, and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How Cars24 scales conversations and builds faster with OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：Cars24的大规模真实世界案例展示了OpenAI语音和聊天代理在业务中的实际规模应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
